description: Creates and saves a trackable Fiveable study plan from the student's topic and available time. Free for signed-in students; uses Fiveable's existing generator and verified resource catalog. Returns a plan id immediately while the plan builds, usually within a minute — read it with get_study_plan, which reports whether it is still building. Reuse requestId with identical input to retry; never call this twice for the same plan.

requestId.description: Unique id for this intended action. Reuse it with identical input on retries.
